肥猴注解：Transition Video手动分段使用说明：
例如：一段原视频有1000帧，一次性生成1000帧可能会爆显存，那么就分成若干段来分段生成。
假设第一段我想生成n帧（例如：200帧），读取原视频的前n+3帧（203帧）,第一段生成出来的视频实际是n~n+3帧（200、201、202、203帧），通过批次节点截断尾部多余帧，输出n帧（200帧）。
然后设置第二段视频跳过原视频的前n帧（200帧），从n+1帧开始（201帧），继续输入n+3帧（203帧）.
并将第一段生成的视频拖入上面的视频加载窗口，节点会通过计算，自动将第一段视频最后21帧输入 Transition Video接口，进行第二段视频将会生成203+21帧，总计224帧。第二段视频的前21帧为过渡帧，可以使两段视频的平滑过渡，最终生成的第二段视频会裁掉前面的21帧过渡帧，和尾部多余的3帧，实际保存200帧视频。

A polished stylized 3D anime female character matching the reference replaces only the person in the driving video. Preserve the exact original room background, camera, lighting, motion timing and full-body fitness movements. Keep the same face and black hair in two buns with straight bangs, hair clips, hoop earrings, black choker, silver star necklace, black sleeveless high-neck crop top with white piping and exact white 07, white pleated skirt with black trim, fitted black shorts, black belt with star belt bag, wristbands, white knee socks with black stripes and stars, compact black-and-white athletic sneakers. Consistent identity and outfit across all frames, natural hands, feet and movement. Hair silhouette is locked throughout every frame and all side and back views: ALL black hair is tightly gathered into EXACTLY TWO compact round buns high on the head. The back of the head is smooth, hair ends at the nape. Neck, shoulders and upper back remain fully exposed. Only short straight forehead bangs and tiny ear wisps. The hairstyle stays the same while turning sideways and raising arms. Exactly one solid character, two arms and two legs, one sharp silhouette throughout the entire continuous full-body dance shot.
